INSERT INTO seller_profile_field_sources (
                profile_id,
                field_path,
                source_type,
                source_confidence,
                created_by_user_id,
                metadata,
                created_at,
                updated_at
            )
            SELECT
                $1,
                'icpNotes[' || gs::text || ']',
                'MANUAL'::seller_profile_source_type,
                'HIGH'::seller_profile_source_confidence,
                $2,
                jsonb_build_object('seed', gs),
                now() - make_interval(mins => gs::int),
                now() - make_interval(mins => gs::int)
            FROM generate_series(1, 210) gs
